<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A 1-bit input signal indicating that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">A 1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The 16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">Divide state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="dividend_reg" width_description="[7:0]" type="register">Register to hold the dividend.</reg>
        <reg id="divisor_reg" width_description="[7:0]" type="register">Register to hold the divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="neg_divisor" width_description="[8:0]" type="register">Register to hold the negative divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="sr" width_description="[15:0]" type="register">Shift register for storing the remainder and quotient.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]" type="register">Counter for tracking the number of iterations.</reg>
        <reg id="start_cnt" type="register">Flag to indicate the start of the division process.</reg>
        <reg id="res_valid_reg" type="register">Register to hold the result validity flag.</reg>
        <wire id="sub_result" width_description="[9:0]">Wire to hold the subtraction result.</wire>
        <wire id="carry_out" type="wire">Wire to hold the carry-out from the subtraction.</wire>
        <wire id="mux_out" width_description="[8:0]">Wire to hold the output of the multiplexer.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the rising edge of the clock or reset
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                // Reset all registers and flags
                dividend_reg <= 8'd0;
                divisor_reg <= 8'd0;
                neg_divisor <= 9'd0;
                sr <= 16'd0;
                cnt <= 4'd0;
                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                // Check if there's a valid operation request and result is not yet valid
                if (opn_valid && !res_valid_reg) begin
                    // Save the dividend and divisor values
                    dividend_reg <= dividend;
                    divisor_reg <= divisor;
                    
                    // Initialize the shift register with the absolute value of the dividend shifted left by one bit
                    sr[15:8] <= {1'b0, dividend};
                    sr[7:0] <= 8'd0;
                    
                    // Calculate the negative divisor
                    neg_divisor <= ~{1'b0, divisor} + 1;
                    
                    // Set the counter to 1 and start_cnt to 1 to begin the division process
                    cnt <= 4'd1;
                    start_cnt <= 1'b1;
                end else if (start_cnt) begin
                    // Check if the most significant bit of the counter is set
                    if (|cnt[3]) begin
                        // Division is complete, update the shift register with the final remainder and quotient
                        sr[15:8] <= mux_out;
                        sr[7:0] <= sub_result[7:0];
                        
                        // Clear the counter and start_cnt flags
                        cnt <= 4'd0;
                        start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                    end else begin
                        // Increment the counter and update the shift register based on the subtraction result
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        sr <= {mux_out, sr[7:1]};
                    end
                end
                
                // Update the result validity flag based on the counter and whether the result has been consumed
                res_valid_reg <= |cnt || res_valid_reg;
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic block to calculate the subtraction result
        assign sub_result = sr[15:8] + neg_divisor;
        
        // Multiplexer to select between the subtraction result and zero based on the carry-out
        assign mux_out = sub_result[9] ? sr[15:8] : sub_result[8:0];
        
        // Assign the result and result validity outputs
        assign result = sr;
        assign res_valid = res_valid_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
